description: Publishes an earlier version's document as the next version (the versions in between stay; the draft is untouched — publishing the draft later is refused with STALE_PUBLISH until you send overwritePublished, and discard_scene_draft makes the draft this version too). expectedVersion (required) is the latest published version you saw (list_scene_versions, list_scenes): if someone published since, nothing changes (STALE_PUBLISH: publishedVersion and what the revert would also take off air). On air it is refused with CONFIRM_REQUIRED like a publish: tell the user, then send confirm: true.

confirm.description: true: you accept what a CONFIRM_REQUIRED refusal named — a stream has this scene on air and viewers see the change at once. Send it only after telling the user.

expectedVersion.description: The latest published version you saw (0: none)

scene.description: The scene (scn_…), from list_scenes or create_scene.

name: revert_scene

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: Publish an earlier version again
